event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 67 percent, barometer 29.80 inches, adjusted
altitude 4,064 feet. 

Collins is 1 - 0 against Stavrinos in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other in a
final round.

Stavrinos goes red to give Collins the win.  Collins lost traction right at the hit, he apparently didn't see
the red light.  He gets back on the throttle and is real loose and close to the centerline.  He kept it in his
lane and he gets the win  He wins his third Wally.
